title: Conserved vertex flows keep class-3 vertex-root pair failures #P-hard
claim: p >= 5, r | p - 1, n graded with a grading-preserving C_r action, d | r, m = m_d of class at most 3. A flow edge is a hard pair of m/gamma_3 satisfying every condition of Theorem 5 of COPRIME-PAIRS-20261027-001E except (V3), together with (F0) no layer-2 vertex data, (F1) injectivity of the deficit maps y -> [D, y] at R_2 and y -> [y, D] at R_1 for every nonzero vertex difference D, and (F2) no vertex-root component in the brackets of the leaves' layer-1 and determined layer-2 parts. If a flow edge exists, counting |Hom(pi_1 S^3_(d/p)(K), G)| is #P-hard. Proof: on the layer-2 variety the vertex equations are a flow conserved at every vertex (bundle identity); Fourier duality turns the count into a spin system on vertex states and potentials; the flow vanishes off the diagonal by (F1) and is bilinear on the diagonal by (F2), so the dual edge weights are non-negative integers; the Brunnian rank witness and subdivision give EVAL(M) for a non-negative M of rank at least two. Decides 8 of the 121 census algebras left open by Theorem 5.
failure_conditions: A vertex equation pair whose endpoint contributions are not exact negatives on a solution, for the stated example.
A nonzero flow on an off-diagonal solution, or an off-diagonal solution with nonzero private layer-1 data, for the stated example.
A diagonal flow that is not bilinear in (layer 1 of one slot) x (layer 2 of the other), or a non-positive Fourier value N(mu).
A flow census other than 16 algebras failing only (V3), of which exactly the 8 listed satisfy (F0)-(F2).
foundation_claim_scope: p >= 5, r | p - 1, graded nilpotent Lie algebras whose ideal m_d has class at most 3, grading-preserving C_r action; manifolds S^3_(d/p)(K). Cited: Theorems 4-5 and lemmas of COPRIME-PAIRS-20261027-001E, the bundle identity of COPRIME-PAIRS-20261027-001A, Lemma I, Bulatov-Grohe via Cai-Chen-Lu. Not covered: the other 8 vertex-root algebras (F0 or F1 fails), class 4, the other open mechanisms. r counts the characters of the action, not Boolean variables. No P versus NP claim.

validation.status: checked: 16 open interacting census algebras fail only (V3) and the flow conditions (F0)-(F2) hold for 8, listed; on free class 3 on (1,1,2) at d = 5, p = 11 the endpoint vertex equations are exact negatives on all diagonal samples and on sampled off-diagonal solutions, the flow vanishes on every sampled off-diagonal solution, and the diagonal flow is exactly bilinear (interpolation validated on fresh points) with every Fourier value N(mu) a positive integer; no human or external review
